Bihar School Examination Board Opens BLET 2026 Registration with Deadline Set for October 31

31 Oct 2026, 12:19 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: sarkariresult.com.cm

Key takeawaysThe Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has officially released the notification and application process for the Bihar Library Eligibility Test (BLET) 2026. Eligible candidates seeking to apply for the examination can complete their registration and fee submissions on

The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has officially released the notification and application process for the Bihar Library Eligibility Test (BLET) 2026. Eligible candidates seeking to apply for the examination can complete their registration and fee submissions online through the official BSEB channels.

Key Schedule and Examination Dates

Online applications for the BLET 2026 opened on October 1, 2026, and the final deadline to submit applications and complete fee payments is October 31, 2026. Following the conclusion of the application window, the examination is currently scheduled to take place between November 19 and December 10, 2026. Result declaration dates have not yet been specified and will be announced later by the board.

Applicants can pay the required examination fees online utilizing several payment modes, including debit cards, credit cards, internet banking, IMPS, cash cards, and mobile wallets.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

To qualify for the Bihar Library Eligibility Test 2026, candidates must fulfill specific nationality, educational, and age prerequisites:

  • Nationality and Residency: Candidates must be Indian citizens and permanent residents of Bihar.
  • Age Limits: The minimum age requirement is 21 years as of August 1, 2026. Maximum age caps vary by category, set at 40 years for General female candidates as well as BC and EBC male and female candidates. For SC and ST male and female candidates, the maximum age limit is 42 years. Specific category-wise relaxations should be verified via the official notification.
  • Educational Qualifications: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree with a minimum of 45% marks from a recognized university, alongside a Bachelor’s degree in Library Science. A 5% relaxation in minimum graduation marks applies to SC, ST, EBC, BC, PwD, women, and EWS candidates who are residents of Bihar. Equivalent qualifications, such as Aalim from Maulana Mazharul Haque Arabic and Persian University, Patna/Bihar State Madrasa Education Board, or Shastri from Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University, are also recognized as equivalent to graduation.

Practical Implications and Verification

Prospective applicants should thoroughly review the official notification regarding specific post-wise age limits, relaxation parameters, and precise qualification rules before filling out the online form. Readers can verify the original announcement, check detailed guidelines, and access the application portal directly through the [Official Sarkari Result Portal](https://sarkariresult.com.cm/bseb-slet-2026/) or via the official BSEB website at [biharboardonline.com](https://biharboardonline.com/).
